title: reference/eedi_diagnostic_questions.jsonl
description: One version of an Eedi diagnostic question per line, unique on `intervention_id`: text, multiple-choice answers, subjects and, where known, construct, year group and level. A question (`parent_question_id`) can have several versions, which differ in names or numbers. Covers only the questions in Eedi's public datasets, a small share of those in provider A's quizzes. Public Eedi data, shipped unchanged. See the dataset card for its sources and licences.

parent_question_id.description: Eedi question ID, shared by all versions of the question. Joins from `assessments/tutoring_provider_a.jsonl` `questions[].parent_question_id`.

intervention_id.description: Eedi identifier for this version of the question. Unique per row.

question_text.description: The question text; may contain LaTeX (e.g. `\( \frac{1}{2} \)`).

subjects.description: The question's place in the subject taxonomy, broadest first. Field names are Eedi's own.

construct_id.description: Joins to `reference/eedi_constructs.jsonl` `construct_id`. Null where Eedi's data gives no construct.

construct_name.description: Null where the construct is unknown or unnamed.
